labels.description: The climate change risk factor now describes concern about global warming, and the concern that may drive additional greenhouse gas regulation and disclosure obligations, as "ongoing" rather than "increasing" (changed in two places); the only other difference is a stray page number (25) removed from the prior text, which is an extraction artifact.
labels.rationale: criterion 3: replacing "increasing" with "ongoing" drops the escalating trajectory of the concern that drives the regulatory and disclosure risk, softening its characterization rather than rewording it with identical meaning.
